user.title: KIRION Atelier
user.description: Installs the KIRION Atelier themes, the glass effect and the Atelier cards. You can change the default theme later in the integration options.

data_description.default_theme: Used on every device where nobody picked a theme in their profile. Each user can still choose their own.

themes_not_loaded.title: KIRION Atelier themes are not loaded
themes_not_loaded.description:
Home Assistant does not read theme files from the `themes` folder. Add this to `configuration.yaml` and restart Home Assistant:

```yaml
frontend:
  themes: !include_dir_merge_named themes
```

If `configuration.yaml` already has a `frontend:` key, add the `themes:` line to it instead of creating a second one. The cards and the glass effect work without this.
